title: The anthem stops the advance
situation: A column of police with shields and lathis advances on students; the crowd begins the national anthem and the officers halt, stand to attention and sing along.

who.officer: Bihar Police column with shields and lathis

lines.text: Officers halted, stood erect and sang along.
lines.speaker: narration

context: Jantar Mantar protesters also sang the anthem and banged plates with spoons on 20 June (Wikipedia timeline).

buildThis.situation: At the charge, Mira can start the anthem; if enough people join within a few seconds the RAF line freezes at attention and the charge is delayed.
